0022600152.text: The Timberwolves (3-2, 2-1 on the road) have lost their last two games and sit third in the Northwest, one game back, and eighth in the West, while the Spurs (3-2, 2-0 on the road) are on a three-game winning streak and sit sixth in the West. Minnesota will be without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and San Antonio will be without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Timberwolves won their 2025-26 regular-season series 2-1 before losing the 2025-26 playoff series 2-4, including a 139-109 defeat in Minneapolis on May 15, 2026.
